allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Welspun Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 19047619 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on December 01, 2025

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: The Board recommended obtaining approval from the shareholders by way of enabling resolution to be passed at the ensuing 31st AGM of the Company, in respect to: i) raising funds through private placement of securities upto Rs. 1,000 Crore (Rupees One Thousand Crore only), in one or more tranches; and ii) raising funds through issuance of securities, including equity shares, or any other eligible securities, through permissible modes.
